messages:
alex: Heads-up — I put a small prototype in staging for a latency-weighted token-cost panel. Quick sync: should the console show raw token cost, latency-weighted cost, or both? Screenshot + query in staging: https://staging.redwood.internal/dash/latency-cost
jin: I think both is ideal but we need a clear formula. Proposal: weighted_cost = token_cost * (1 + alpha * (p95_latency_ms / 1000)). alpha default 0.5 so latency only nudges cost not dominates. Also keep raw tokens next to it for transparency.
ram: +1 on both. Important: allocate cache savings carefully — if we credit prefetch/KV cache entirely to the hotpath we'll double-count when that same session hits other routes. Suggest amortize cache savings across the session/window (e.g., 5–15 min) and attribute proportional to invocation cost in that window.
taylor: UX note: "latency-weighted" will confuse some PMs. We should display a labeled toggle and tooltip with a tiny worked example: "If raw token cost = $0.10 and p95=200ms -> weighted = $0.11 (alpha=0.5)". Maybe also show a normalized "cost per 1k tokens" sparklines for trend reading.
alex: Good call. Also question for infra: telemetry naming. We currently emit invocation.* events. Do we add invocation.econ.weighted_cost_v1 or piggyback on invocation.econ.token_cost? I'd prefer a separate metric to allow backfill/changes.
jin: New metric namespace is safer. Something like invocation.econ.token_cost_ms.weighted_v1 and invocation.econ.token_cost.raw_v1. Keep the raw name stable for billing backfills.
ram: Implementation note: accurate weighted computations are OLAP-friendly but expensive for realtime. For console realtime we can surface an EWMA approximation (windowed p95 proxy) and compute exact values in nightly OLAP for historical charts.
taylor: Admin/tenant setting: can we default-amortize cache savings for enterprise tenants (opt-out) and show a clear disclosure? Also add a small "why this changed" banner during rollout when values differ from old panel.
alex: Rollout idea: feature-flag + small cohort (10%) where both metrics shown + contextual help. Collect clickthrough to the tooltip and a "helpful? yes/no" micro-survey. We should also log UI impressions -> invocation.econ.ui.impression.latency_weighted.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging dashboard updated by alex (build #1789). Collector flag 'econ.weighted_v1' enabled for staging.
jin: Edge case: model variant switch mid-session — cache amortization should be tied to model family or cache key namespace, not SKU. Otherwise we misattribute cold-starts.
ram: Agree. Also a policy: don't expose per-token microcosts in the customer billing UI yet — keep this internal for teams while we validate. Public billing stays per-invocation SKU.
taylor: Action items I can take: 1) write tooltip copy + examples, 2) mock small banner copy for rollout. jin: can you draft metric names and event contracts? ram: can you sketch OLAP vs realtime pipeline and an EWMA proxy? alex: I'll open the console PR and flag for PM review.
alex: I'll schedule a 15-min demo Fri 10am if that works. If no objections I'll start the feature-flag rollout early next week.
jin: :thumbsup:
ram: :thumbsup:
taylor: Sounds good to me
